# Surf With Tee

> Surf With Tee is a surf school based in Uluwatu, Bali, Indonesia, run by local instructor Tee with 10+ years of experience teaching beginners to advanced surfers at Balangan Beach.

## About

Surf With Tee offers beginner to advanced surf lessons at Balangan Beach, Uluwatu, Bali. Instructor Tee was born and raised in Bali and has surfed the breaks of Uluwatu his whole life. He has taught 500+ students from around the world, with a 100% first-wave success rate and a 5-star average rating.

Sessions run daily from 07:00–18:00 at Jl. Pantai Balangan 315, Jimbaran, Bali.

## Services & Pricing

- **Group Lesson** — 2 hours, 1 instructor per 3 students, IDR 400,000 per person
- **Semi-Private Lesson** — 2 hours, 1 instructor per 2 students, IDR 500,000 per person
- **Private Lesson** — 2 hours, 1-on-1 coaching, IDR 700,000 per person
- **Board Rental** — IDR 100,000 per board per hour
- **3-Day Private Camp** — IDR 1,900,000
- **3-Day Semi-Private Camp** — IDR 2,800,000
- **3-Day Group Camp** — IDR 3,400,000

All sessions include: surfboard, rashguard, zinc/sunscreen, locker, coffee/tea/water.
Photo & video add-on: +IDR 300,000.

## Skill Levels

- Level I (Beginner): surf equipment & safety, paddling, pop-up technique
- Level II: comfortable in line-up, turtle rolls, whitewater waves
- Level III: catching unbroken waves, timing, dropping down the face
- Level IV (Advanced): wave reading, angling take-offs, trimming vs carving

## Cancellation Policy

- 14+ days before session: 100% refund

- Less than 7 days before session: Non-refundable
- Poor weather reschedules: alternative session always offered
